spans.s:
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Averse, indifferent, free from inclination or affection.
2 Stoical, void of attachment to worldly objects.
3 Empassioned, interested, feeling passion or regard for any person or any thing.
E.
वि privative or pleonastic, before रञ्ज to feel passion, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Disinclined to, disliking.
E.
विरक्त, and भाव quality.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Aversion, disinclination.
2 Absence of affection.
E.
वि before रञ्ज to affect, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-चन्-चन्ती-चत्)
Making, composing, fabricating, embellishing, &c.
E.
वि before रच to make, aff. शतृ.

Making.
2

Composing.
3

Embellishing.
4

Embellishment, any artificial and ornamental fabric or contrivance.
E.
वि before र to make, युच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Made, prepared, effected.
2 Written, composed.
3 Trimmed, ornamented.
4 Contrived, constructed, arranged.
E.
वि pleonasm, and रच made, क्त aff.

ind.
Having made.
E.
वि, रच to make, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः)
Free from dust.
f. (-जाः)
A woman who has ceased to menstruate.
E.
वि privative, रजस् the menses.

m. (-माः)
A virtuous man, one free form the two properties of ignorance and passion.
E.
वि privative, रजस the quality of passion, and तमस् that of ignorance.

f. (-जा)
1 A plant, commonly कवित्थानी.
2 A sort of grass, commonly Dūb.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Exempt or freed from passion.
2 Clean, freed from dust, &c.
E.
वि priv., रजस् passion, &c., कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Free from passion, pure, holy.
2 Clean, clear.
E.
वि priv., रजस् passion, भूत become, च्चि augment.

m. (-ञ्चः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
वि before रच to create, aff. अच्, and नुम् augment, more properly विरिञ्च.

m. (-टः)
1 The name of a king.
2 The shoulder.
3 A black kind of Agallochum.

m. (-टः)
1 A country, one of the midland divisions of India, probably

Berar.
2

A sovereign.
E.
वि before रट to sound, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon schœnanthum.)
E.
see वीरण.

n. (-नं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
f. (-णी)
A side glance, a leer.
3 A deep place.
E.
वि a bird, ईर to go, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Stopped, ceased, rested.
E.
वि before रम to stop or rest, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Heroism.
E.
तल् added to वीर; also with त्व aff. वीरत्वं.

f. (-तिः)
1 Stop, cessation, term, rest.
2 End, term.
E.
वि before रम to play, क्तिन् aff.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
1 Resting, stopping.
2 Sporting.
E.
वि before रम to sport, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Fine, delicate, thin, (but with interstices.)
2 Loose, relaxed.
4 Apart, wide, separated by an interval.
4 Remote, rare, occurring at distant or repeated intervals of time.
n. (-लं)
Sour curds.
E.
वि apart, रा to go or be, aff. कलन्.

m. (-लः)
A cat.
E.
विडाल as above, and ड changed to र.

m. (-कः)
A man with bandy legs.
E.
विरल wide, and जानु the knee, कन् added.

f. (-वा)
Gruel made of rice or other grain, with the addition, of Ghee, &c.
E.
विरल apart, द्रु to ooze, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Insipid.
E.
वि, and रस flavour.

m. (-हः)
1 Separation, parting, absence, especially the separation of lovers.
2 Forbearance, cessation, relinquishment.
E.
वि before रह to abandon, aff. अच्.

ind.
Having abandoned.
E.
वि before रह to quit, causal form, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Pained by the absence of a lover.
E.
विरह, and आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Left, abandoned, deserted, relinquished.
2 Void of exempt, or free from.
E.
वि before रह to abandon, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
Separate, sundered, absent or apart from.
f. (-हिणी)
1 Wages, hire.
2 A woman absent from her husband or lover.
E.
विरह absence, इनि aff.

f. (-ता)
A woman whose lover or husband is absent.
E.
विरह separation, उत्कण्ठित afflicted.

m. (-गः)
The absence of desire or passion, indifference, philosophy, the disregard of all sensual enjoyment either in [] this world or the next.
E.
वि privative, and राग passion, desire.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
Void of passion or desire.
E.
विराग the absence of desire, and अर्ह worthy.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Void of passion or desire.
E.
विराग, and इनि aff.

m. (-राट्)
1 A man of the regal or military class.
2 Splendour, beauty.
3 The first progeny of BRAHMĀ, who having divided himself into male and female, produced from the female, VIRĀJ; VIRĀJ then by himself produced the first Menu or SVAYAMBHUVA, who was the progenitor of the Prajāpatis, and the secondary framer of the visible world: in other places VIRĀJ is the same as BRAHMĀ, and assumer of the androgynous form in his own person.
E.
वि severally or separately, &c., राज to shine, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-जन्-जन्ती-जत्)
Shining, splendid, handsome.
E.
वि, and राज to shine, aff. शतृ.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Splendid, brilliant, handsome.
E.
वि before राज to shine, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Illuminated, irradiated, splendid.
2 Manifested, made visible.
E.
वि before राज to shine, क्त aff.

m. (-जः)
An inferior sort of diamond, said to be found in the country Virāṭa.
E.
विराट the country, and ज produced.

m. (-णी)
An elephant.
E.
वि before रण battle, aff. अण्, and इनि added.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Treated with disrespect, reviled, abused.
2

Opposed.
3

Offended.
E.
वि before राध to accomplish, क्त aff.

mfn. (-द्धा-द्धी-द्धृ)
1 Thwarting, opposing.
2 Offending, injuring.
3 Abusive, calumnious.
E.
वि before राध to accomplish, aff. तृच्.

m. (-धः)
1 Opposition, prevention.
2 Vexation, annoyance.
E.
वि before राध to accomplish, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Pain, agony, anguish.

mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्)
1 Opposing, thwarting.
2 Offending, annoying, injuring.
E.
वि before राध to accomplish, शतृ aff.

m. (-मः)
1 End, conclusion, cessation, term.
2 Rest, cessation from labour.
3 Stop, pause.
4 Interval between words or sentences.
E.
वि before रम to stop, aff. घञ्.

m. (-वः)
Sound, noise.
E.
वि before रु to make a noise, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि)
Shouting, roaring, crying, &c.
f. (-णी)
1 A broom.
2 The name of a river.
3 Weeping, crying.
E.
विराव noise, इनि and ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Purged.
E.
वि before रिच to void by stool, क्त aff.

m. (-ञ्चः)
BRAHMĀ: see विरिञ्चि.

m. (-नः)
BRAHMĀ: see the next.

BRAHMĀ.
2
VIṢṆ

ŚIVA.
E.
वि implying various kinds, (of beings,) रच to make or create, इन् aff., the radical vowel changed to इ, and नुम् augment; also withअच् aff. विरिञ्च, and with युच्, विरिञ्चन; some authorities omit the change of the radical vowel, and write विरञ्च and विरञ्चि, but these seem to be less accurate.

m. (-ब्धः)
A note, a tone.
E.
वि before रेभ to sound, क्त aff., इट् augment, form irr.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
1 Broken, bent.
2

Blunted.
3

Destroyed.
E.
वि before रुज to be sick, क्त aff.

Crying.
2

Proclaiming.
E.
वि, रुद to cry, क aff.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Opposed, hindered.
2 Reverse, contrary, opposite.
3 Inconsistent, (in argument,) incongruous, a nonsequitur.
4 Opposed in quality, as sweet with sour, &c.
5 Disagreeing with each other, (as articles of medicine or food.)
6 Hostile, adverse.
7 Excluded, disqualified.
8 Surrounded, blockaded.
E.
वि before रुध to stop, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
1 Opposition, contraiety.
2

Incongruity.
3

Enmity.
E.
तल् added to विरुद्ध; also with त्व, विरुद्धत्वं.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Eating incompatible things.
E.
विरुद्ध, and भुज who eats.

n. (-नं)
Incompatible food.
E.
विरुद्ध, and भोजन eating.

n. (-न्नं)
Incompatible food.
E.
विरुद्ध, and अन्न food.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Astringent, drying.
n. (-णं)
1 Censure, blame, reviling, abuse.
2 Oath, imprecation.
3 Contracting, roughening, acting as an astringent.
E.
वि before रूक्ष to be rough, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Budded, blossomed.
2 Born.
E.
वि before रुह to grow, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-पः-पा or -पी-पं)
1 Deformed, monstrous.
2 Unusual in form or nature, unnatural.
n. (-पं)
1 Irregular or monstrous shape.
2 Difference of nature or character.
f. (-पा)
The wife of YAMA.
E.
वि implying variety, and रूप form.

mfn. (-कः-पिका-कं)
1 Frightful, hideous.
2 Deformed, mis-shapen.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-णं)
Disfiguring.
E.
विरूप, and करण making.

IVA.
2

One of the Rudras.
E.
वि implying reverse, रूप form, and अक्ष the eye; having three eyes.

m. (-कः)
1 Purging, evacuation by stool.
2 A purgative.
E.
वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Purging, evacuation by stool.
2 A purgative.
E.
वि before रिच to purge, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Purged, evacuated.
E.
वि before रिच to purge, क्त aff.

mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं)
To be purged.
E.
वि, रिच to purge, यत् aff.

m. (-फः)
1 A river in general.
2 The absence of the letter र.
E.
वि privative, रेफ the letter र, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded, uttered.
E.
वि before रेभे to sound, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
A hole, a chasm.
m. (-कः)
A ray of light.
E.
वि before रुच to shine, aff. घञ्.

m. (-नः)
1 The sun.
2 The moon.
3

Fire.
4

The son of the sovereign PRAHLĀDA.
E.
वि before रुच to shine, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-तः)
BALI, the sovereign of Mahābalipura.
E.
विरोचन the son of PRAHLĀDA, and सुत son.

Shining.
2

Illuminating.
E.
वि before रुच to be light, इष्णुच् aff.

m. (-धः)
1 Enmity, animosity.
2 Restraint, check, controul, confinement.
3 Opposition, contradiction.
4 Preventing, hindrance.
5

War.
6

Calamity, misfortune.
7 Surrounding, investing, siege, blockade.
8 Impediment to a successful progress of the story (in a play).
9 Antithesis, contrast.
10 Opposition of qualities (in articles of food or medicine, &c.)
11 Inconsistency, (in argument.)
f. (-धी)
Fixed rule, ordinance, institute.
E.
वि before रुध to stop, aff. घञ्.

n. (-नं)
1 Opposition, resistance, contradiction.
2 Hindering, obstructing, preventing.
3 Incongruity, inconsistency.
4 Taunting, provoking.
5 Encountering or defying peril.
6 Investing, blockading.
E.
वि before रुध to stop, aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-कृत्)
The forty-fifth year of the Indian cycle.
E.
विरोधि opposition, कृत् making.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
1 Inimical, adverse, hostile.
2 Opposing, preventing.
3

Obstructive.
4

Exclusive, disqualifying.
5 Contradictory, inconsistent.
6 Quarrelsome, contentious.
7 Of opposite and incompatible quality, (food, medicine, &c.)
8 Besieging, blockading.
m. (-धी)
1 An enemy, an opponent.
2 The twenty-fourth year of the cycle.
E.
विरोध enmity, aff. इनि.

f. (-क्तिः)
Quarrel, dispute, mutual contradiction.
E.
विरोध contradiction, and उक्ति speech.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Left, destitute, forsaken.
E.
वि, रुह to ascend, क्त aff.

r. 10th cl. (वीरयति)
To be powerful or valiant, to make heroic or irresistible effort.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Excellent, eminent, (used chiefly in composition.)
2

Heroic.
3

Powerful, mighty.
4 Strong, robust.
m. (-रः)
1 A hero, a warrior, a champion.
2 Heroism, the heroic Rasa or feeling, as an object of poetical description especially.
3 The last Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present æra.
4 An actor, a mime.
5 A flower, (Nerium odorum.)
6

Fire.
7

Sacrificial fire.
f. (-रा)
1 A matron, a wife and mother.
2 A sort of perfume, commonly

Murā.
3

A medicinal root, commonly Kṣīrakākolī.
4 A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.)
5 A drug, (Elavāluka.)
6 Plaintain tree.
7 A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea.)
8 Opposite-leaved fig tree.
9 A sort of Convolvulus, (C. paniculatus, the white and dark kinds.)
10 A small tree, (Gmelina arborea.)
11 Spirituous liquor or a particular kind of it.
12 The aloe.
13 A plant, commonly Atis.
n. (-रं)
1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis.)
2 The root of the ginger plant. (?)
3

Pepper.
4

Rice-gruel.
5 The root of the Costus speciosus.
6 The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
अज to go, and वी substituted for the root, रक् Uṇādi aff., or वीर to be powerful, aff. क.

f. (-का)
1 A war-dance, a dance performed by soldiers after a victory or on going to battle.
2 War, battle.
E.
वीर a hero, जि to conquer, झच् aff., fem. form, and कन् added.

n. (-रं)
1 A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
m. (-रः)
1 An arrow.
2 A distinguished hero.
3 A corpse. (?)
E.
वीर powerful, तरप् aff.

m. (-रुः)
1 A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna, Rox.)
2 A shrub, (Barleria longifolia, Rox.)
E.
वीर a hero, and तरु the tree.

m. (-न्वा)
KĀMA or CUPID.
E.
वीर a hero, and धन्वन् a bow.

m. (-रः)
1 A peacock.
2 Fighting with wild beasts.
3 A leather cuirass or jacket.
4 The name of a river.
E.
वीर a hero, धृ to hold, खच् aff.

f. (-त्नी)
The wife of a hero.
E.
वीर a hero, and पत्नी the wife.

n. (-णं)
The drink of warriors, taken during the battle for refreshment, or before it, to elevate courage.
E.
वीर a hero, and पान drink; the न is optionally changed, whence it also occurs वीरपान.

m. (-द्रः)
1 A horse fit for the Aśvamedha sacrifice.
2 A distinguished hero.
3 A fragrant grass, &c. वीरण.
4 One of ŚIVA'S attendants.
5 One of the Rudras.
E.
वीर a hero, and भद्र auspicious.

n. (-कं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-र्य्या)
The wife of a hero.
E.
वीर a hero, and भार्य्या a wife.

f. (-ता)
The mother of a hero.
E.
वीर, and मातृ mother.

f. (-का)
An ornament or ring worn on the middle toe.
E.
वीर a hero, मुद्रा a seal, कन् aff.

m. (-णुः)
A name of BHĪMASENA.
E.
त्रीर a hero, and रेणु dust.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a champion or hero.
f. (-ती)
A woman whose husband is living.
E.
वीर, and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-त्सा)
The mother of a hero.
E.
वीर, and वत्स the child, (of whom.)

m. (-कः)
A Brahman, who performs his oblations with money, procured from the lower or Śūdra tribe.
E.
वीर sacrificial fire, वि before प्लु to go, ण्वुल् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 The marking-nut plant, (Semicarpus anacardium.)
2 A large tree, (Pentaptera Arjuna.)
3 A sort of grain, (Andropogon or Holcus sorghum.)
E.
वीर strong or a hero, and वृक्ष a tree.

f. (-सूः)
1 The mother of a hero.
2 The mother of a male child.
E.
वीर a hero, and सू mother.

m. (-नः)
The father of NALA Rāja.
E.
वीर a hero, and सेना a host.

m. (-जः)
NALA, a prince and hero of several celebrated poems, as the Naiṣadha, Nalodaya, &c.
E.
वीरसेन the father of the prince, and ज born.

n. (-न्यं)
Garlic.

m. (-न्धः)
A buffalo.
E.
वीर powerful, स्कन्ध the shoulder.

m. (-हा)
A Brahman, who has suffered the sacred domestic fire to become extinct, either from carelessness, impiety, or absence.
E.
वीर sacrificial fire, and हन् who destroys.

n. (-नं)
1 The post of danger, the place in battle which is most perilous and exposed.
2 Keeping watch.
E.
वीर a hero, आङ् before शसि to wish, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Sleeping out in the open air, a bivouac.
2 A field of battle.
3 A kneeling posture.
E.
वीर, and आसन sitting.

f. (-रुट् or -रुत्)
1 A creeper or spreading creeper.
2 A branch and shoot.
E.
वि before रुध to impede, aff. क्विप्, and the vowel of the prefix made long; also टाप् being added, वीरुधा f. (-धा.)

m. (-रः)
1 VĪRABHADRA, one of ŚIVA'S attendants.
2 A great hero.
E.
वीर a hero, and ईश्वर lord or chief.

m. (-ञ्झः)
A Brahman, who omits offering burnt offerings or neglects his sacrificial fire.
E.
वीर fire, उञ्झ to abandon, aff. अण्.

m. (-कः)
A Brahman, who claims alms or presents, on the merit of having preserved his sacrificial fire.
E.
वीर sacrificial fire, and उपजीविक living by.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Strength, vigour, power.
2 Dignity, consequence.
3 Fortitude, firmness.
4 Semen virile.
5 Splendour, lustre.
6 Heroism, valour.
7 Seed, (of plants, &c.)
E.
वीर a hero, and यत् aff., or वीर to be strong, and अच् and यत् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Strong, stout, robust.
2 Overcoming, victorious.
E.
वीर्य्य strength, मतुप् poss. aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Devoid of prowess or vigour, &c.
E.
वीर्य्य, and विरहित deprived of.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Possessed of courage, vigour, &c.
E.
वीर्य्य, and विशिष्ट endowed with.

f. (-निः)
1 Loss of vigour or courage.
2 Impotence.
E.
वीर्य्य, and हानि loss.

Seedless.
2

Cowardly.
E.
वीर्य्य, and हीन void of.

n. (-नं)
Effecting any thing by prowess.
E.
वीर्य्य, and अवदान end.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Overcome or surpassed in prowess.
E.
वीर्य्य, and अवधूत shaken.
